name: .257 Cal-067gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Small to Medium Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This Stone Hammer™ is designed for the 1-14″ twist rate or faster. A great bullet for young hunters or anyone else that is recoil sensitive. With 90% weight retention and the large 2.5mm hollow point it will still be quite effective on deer and pigs and any other small to medium game."
